properties.name: Bilbali
properties.source: Warhammer Fantasy Roleplay 4e: Sea of Claws

wiki.title: Bilbali
wiki.description: Bilbali, officially the Kingdom of Bilbali, is the second largest settlement in Estalia, second only to Magritta, and the primary population centre in the north of the country. Bilbali officially rules an area between the sea in the north and the River Tarmos. Together with Magritta, it is currently one of the two most powerful kingdoms of Estalia.

properties.name: Magritta
properties.source: Warhammer Fantasy Roleplay 4e: Sea of Claws

wiki.title: Magritta
wiki.description: Magritta, formally the Kingdom of Magritta, is the largest and one of the most important cities in Estalia. Built by natural deep-water harbours within the sheltered Bay of Quietude, its reputation as a friendly port with ready markets for all manner of cargoes draws traders from many ports across the world of Mallus. Its quays are usually crowded, and, among the assortment of Old Worlder merchantmen, one can occasionally catch a glimpse of a strangely rigged craft from Araby or even further afield.

wiki.title: Nerja
wiki.description: Nerja, also known as Nuja, is a port town of the Kingdom of Avila facing the Orchid Coast in south-western Estalia.

wiki.title: Siernos
wiki.description: Siernos was an inland town in the Irrana Mountains of Estalia. It was burned to the ground for three days during the 26th century IC by Sienna Fuegonasus a Bright Wizard.

properties.name: Almyria
properties.source: The Road to Damnation (Short Story) by Brian Craig

wiki.title: Almyria
wiki.description: Almyria is an independent, Estalian city-state. It is smaller in size and power than its neighbouring city of Magritta. Almyria's royal family is perennially engaged in attempting to murder one another.

wiki.title: Barsellon
wiki.description: Barsellon is a northern hill-side city of Estalia. Its inhabitants have an impossibly thick accent in the Estalian language that is also called Barsellon.

wiki.title: Durango
wiki.description: Durango is a town of the Estalian Kingdom of Novareno.

wiki.title: Monteñas
wiki.description: Monteñas, or simply Montenas, is a fortified town of the Estalian Kingdom of Magritta in the western Irrana Mountains. It possesses a temperate climate.

wiki.title: Zaragoz
wiki.description: Not to be confused with the Princedom of Zaragoz in the Border Princes. Zaragoz, also spelled Zaraguz, and officially the Dukedom of Zaragoz, is a tiny independent realm based on the town of the same name that lies high in the Irrana Mountains at the source of the River Eboro in eastern Estalia. It is an ethnically Estalian dukedom once ruled by Duke Marsilio diAvila, called a tyrant by his people.

wiki.title: Gualcazar
wiki.description: Gualcazar is an independent Estalian domain, located in the realm of Cantonia. Here the last member of the Quixana family found refuge for a time.

properties.name: Larghoz
properties.source: Warhammer Fantasy Battles (8th Edition) - Monstrous Arcanum

properties.name: Geulata
properties.source: Warhammer Fantasy Battles (8th Edition) - Monstrous Arcanum

wiki.title: Geulata
wiki.description: Geulata, formally the Kingdom of Geulata, is a kingdom of Estalia allied with the Kingdom of Larhgoz. Geulata borders the city-state of Vedenza of the Tilean Principality of Tobaro in south-eastern Estalia.

wiki.title: Porto Espejo
wiki.description: Porto Espejo was a small trading town located on the southern coast of Estalia. Porto Espejo possessed a fair natural harbour which was popular with the local fishing boats. Yet not a scrap of this small town remained intact after a raid by the Butcher Ship.

wiki.title: Aguilas
wiki.description: Aguilas also known as Aquilas, and Aquilia, is the southernmost of the old port cities in eastern Estalia within the Aquilas Bay. For centuries, this Estalian city-state has been a centre for trade with a good, deep harbour. It is also famed for its drydocks and shipyards, which provide many vessels for the Estalian Navy.

wiki.title: Porto Real
wiki.description: Porto Real (which means "Port Royale") is a small town and a colonial port of Estalia located on a bay close to Cap D'Orient in Tobaran territory. Beyond the Abasko Mountains, Estalia's eastern coast is rendered all but impassable to large ocean-going vessels by the presence of innumerable small islands that stretch from the Golfo di Forore in the north to Fool's Point in the south. At the southernmost extent of this vast archipelago, the Estalian city of Porto Real stands on one of the largest islands, south of Isla Verde, a safe haven for vessels not wishing to venture into larger harbors, including ships out of Sartosa.

wiki.title: Avila
wiki.description: Avila is a kingdom of south-western Estalia. Recently the lords of Bilbali and Magritta have come into conflict due to a vendetta. As a result, they have placed an embargo on all trade between the two kingdoms and consequently, also on the minor Estalian realms that must deal with them both, such as Obregon and Avila.

wiki.title: Sitges
wiki.description: Sitges is an Estalian port town of the kingdom of Cantonia located on the Aguilas Bay.

wiki.title: Almagora
wiki.description: Almagora is a port town of the Kingdom of Cantonia located on the Bay of Quietude in south-eastern Estalia.

wiki.title: Jávea
wiki.description: Jávea, also spelled Javea, is a port town of the kingdom of Cantonia located on the Bay of Quietude in southern Estalia.

wiki.title: Torrosa
wiki.description: Torrosa is an Estalian port town of the Kingdom of Magritta located on the Bay of Quietude.

wiki.title: San Pedro del Sur
wiki.description: San Pedro del Sur is a port town located in the kingdom of Avila on the Golfo Naranja in south-western Estalia.

wiki.title: Ubrique
wiki.description: Ubrique is a port town of the Kingdom of Magritta located on the Golfo di Naranja in southern Estalia.

wiki.title: Los Cabos
wiki.description: Los Cabos is a port town located in the Kingdom of Avila in south-western Estalia. Los Cabos lies off Estalia's westernmost tip at the Cabo de la Diestros. Situated a mere stone's throw from Los Cabos, the High Elf colony of Ocean's Gate has an especially close relationship with their Estalian neighbours.

wiki.title: San Luis
wiki.description: San Luis is a town of the Estalian Kingdom of Obregon. Despite its location in the vicinity of the Silver Sea and the Irranan Sea, San Luis lacks an outlet to the Southern Sea.

wiki.title: Azuara
wiki.description: Azuara is a town of the Estalian Kingdom of Novareno.

wiki.title: Potes
wiki.description: Potes is a town of the Estalian Kingdom of Bilbali.

wiki.title: Sahagún
wiki.description: Sahagún is a town of the Estalian Kingdom of Obregon located near the Céfiro Hills.

wiki.title: Verin
wiki.description: Verin is a town of the Estalian Kingdom of Obregon.

wiki.title: Cebreros
wiki.description: Cebreros is a town of the Estalian Kingdom of Magritta.

wiki.title: Jaraiz
wiki.description: Jaraiz is a town of the Estalian Kingdom of Obregon.

wiki.title: Solsona
wiki.description: Solsona is a town of the Estalian kingdom of Cantonia.

wiki.title: Ragaños
wiki.description: Ragaños is a town of the Estalian kingdom of Cantonia.

wiki.title: Graus
wiki.description: Graus is a village located in the Estalian Kingdom of Novareno, on the shore of the Bay of Brionne.

wiki.title: Santa Bernadette
wiki.description: Santa Bernadette is located in the Southern Littoral of Estalia, nine days of navigation southwest of Porto Real, among the last thickets of green islets before the bony expanses of the bare atolls and daggers that emerge at the edge of the Known Land and herald the great, dark oceans of the mysterious west. The freeport of Santa Bernadette is one of the few places assumed in a first moment to be free from the raids of the Butcher Ship in the island chain of the Estalian Littoral. Or at least the only place of any real size.

wiki.title: Astorias
wiki.description: Astorias is a town plagued by the infamous Chaos Spawn known as El Phantazi.
